text:
sara_support: AcmeCorp reporting p99 spikes (~11s) and intermittent 504s starting ~09:40 UTC. Customer says requests pile up then backend 504s. They attached a short curl repro and traces: https://acme.example/repro

sara_support: key errors in their logs: 
```
2026-03-17T09:40:12Z ERROR request/ingress admission_reject tenant=acme reason=queue_full inflight=212
2026-03-17T09:40:13Z WARN runtime/kvcache miss seq_len=4096 tenant=acme
```

mike_oncall: Looking. On our side I see a sharp bump in admission.rejects for tenant=acme at 09:38 and worker CPU hitting 98% on model-embed-workers pool. Also small number of long-running requests (seq_len>2048).

jon_eng-runtime: Can you paste /metrics or the runtime trace ids? My hunch: either long-seq requests thrashing KV cache or a congestion point in the fanout path causing backlog.

sara_support: Pasted traces link in ticket: https://redwood.at/replay/trace/abc123 (short).

lee_sre: We also had 2 OOM-kills on eu-west-1-gpu-3 around 09:38 that coincided with the spike; nodes briefly bounced which could amplify queuing.

nina_supportlead: Customer is asking for ETA. Quick mitigations: 1) route Acme to a lower-context model variant, 2) temporarily tighten admission limits per-tenant, 3) enable fast-fail for requests > 4096 tokens. Thoughts?

jon_eng-runtime: Agreed. Applied an emergency tweak: decreased admission.max_inflight for tenant acme from 200 -> 120 and enabled short-circuit for seq_len>4096. Rolling to 3 nodes now. Command used: 
```
redwoodctl tenant update acme --set admission.max_inflight=120 --set admission.fast_fail_seq=4096
```

mike_oncall: Patch rolled out (3/3). Monitoring p95/p99 now.

sara_support: Told customer: "we're applying mitigations (routing + limits) and continuing to investigate root cause; will update in 15m" :thumbsup:

lee_sre: Early signal: p95 dropped 520ms -> 210ms and p99 from ~8.9s -> ~1.6s on affected routes after the tweak and node restarts. Admission rejects fell back to baseline.

jon_eng-runtime: Next steps: enable request logging for seq_len>2048 for 1h, add temporary routing rule to send Acme to small-context model variant until we fix underlying memory/eviction issue, and plan a proper patch to improve KV cache eviction policy.

nina_supportlead: I'll file an incident follow-up with customer-facing summary and ask biz-ops about credits. Also add action item for runtime to prioritize cache eviction tuning.

sara_support: Added logs and customer update to ticket. Customer asked for a follow-up call, scheduling now.

mike_oncall: Will mark channel stable and close after 30m of steady metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T10:05:10Z: emergency config applied (rollout: 3/3).
